role_archetypes.responsibility: Check kit source files, schema compliance, lifecycle state, and entry consistency.
Review whether the kit boundary is closed, reusable, and not materially overlapping another kit.
Review decision gates, failure paths, revision loops, delivery steps, and closure logic.
Review role, mate, assignment, and roster responsibility clarity.
Review approval points, risk levels, permission expansion, and irreversible action controls.
Review usefulness, acceptance criteria, deliverability, and user-facing language fit.
Convert non-blocking findings into concise level notes without creating process logs.
Review Askdo rules, flows, schemas, skills, templates, adapters, and public language consistency.
